# AI Content Governance & Brand Safety — key ideas (one page)

## What you can now do

- Define disclosure
- provenance and rights rules for generated content
- Set review workflows for AI-generated campaigns
- Manage deepfake and impersonation risk to the brand

## The sentences to remember

1. **Rules for generated content: a policy you can run** — “A content policy nobody can test is a poster. Write it as rules you can run against an asset.”
2. **Brand risk: deepfake and impersonation response playbook** — “You cannot stop someone cloning your CEO. You can decide today who does what in the first hour.”
